page.layout: One title page, all lines centred. Top: the main title block (LEXICON, NOVUM, Hebraeo-Latinum, the Schreveliani line, and the imprint-style paragraph in several lines). Middle: "Atque adauctum" and "Lexico Chaldaico-Biblico". Below: the author's name, then a woodcut engraving in the centre, with "ULTRAJECTI," and the printer's imprint at the foot. Library stamp at right and shelf mark at left are not printed text and are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Per modum Indicis Hebraici primò à D. ROBERTSONO-
Sed jam latinitate donatum , atque Textibus , continentibus

page.notes: Engraving between the author line and ULTRAJECTI: a woodcut showing two figures in classical dress, one holding a book and one with a sheaf or palm, a banner reading "VIVITURINGENI" (partly unclear, possibly "VIVITURINGENI"; the letters are small and doubtful), a mask at the lower left, books and a landscape with a rising sun or dome. Not transcribed as text. The "Textibus" word in the italic line is set in roman type on the scan; the italic/roman distinction there is a best reading. Stamp "BIBL: STUD: ACAD: LAUS." and handwritten shelf mark "AZ 7238 (1)" and Google digitiser mark are excluded as not printed text.
